description: This file contains helper functions for Flask, including response creation, URL generation, file sending, and session flashing, with project-specific references to Flask globals and Werkzeug utilities.

methods.name: get_debug_flag
methods.description: Checks environment variable 'FLASK_DEBUG' to determine if debug mode is enabled.

methods.name: get_load_dotenv
methods.description: Checks environment variable 'FLASK_SKIP_DOTENV' to determine if dotenv files should be loaded.

methods.name: stream_with_context
methods.description: Decorator and wrapper to run a generator function within the current Flask request context, preserving request, session, and g.

methods.name: make_response
methods.description: Creates a Flask Response object from view return values, allowing headers to be added.

methods.name: url_for
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given endpoint with optional parameters, considering current request or app context.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a redirect response to a specified location, using current app's redirect method if available.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Raises an HTTPException for a given status code, using current app's aborter if available.

methods.name: get_template_attribute
methods.description: Loads a macro or variable from a template for use in Python code.

methods.name: flash
methods.description: Flashes a message to the session for display on the next request, with category support.

methods.name: get_flashed_messages
methods.description: Retrieves flashed messages from the session, optionally filtered by category and with categories.

methods.name: send_file
methods.description: Sends a file to the client, supporting file paths and file-like objects, with options for caching, MIME type, and headers.

methods.name: send_from_directory
methods.description: Sends a file from within a specified directory, securely serving static or uploaded files.

methods.name: get_root_path
methods.description: Finds the root path of a package or module, with fallback to current working directory.

methods.name: _split_blueprint_path
methods.description: Splits a dotted blueprint name into its components, cached for efficiency.
